title: Ya bunayya ilayya
body:
De raha hai sada ek lasha
<<MINI>>
ya bunayya ilayya ilayya
<<DIVIDER>>
Sooe darya nahi'n jaao beta
<<MINI>>
ya bunayya ilayya ilayya
<<DIVIDER>>
Sakina sakina
Door darya hai laashe pade hai
Ab bhi zaalim wahaa'n par khade hai
Tum ko bhi qatl kar de na aada
<<MINI>>
ya bunayya ilayya ilayya
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum ko hai apne ammu se ulfat
kam nahi'n karte hum bhi mohabbat
kya na maanogi baba ka kehna
<<MINI>>
ya bunayya ilayya ilayya
<<DIVIDER>>
Us taraf dekho beta na jaao
neel gaalo'n ke humko dikhaao
keh do hum se jo hai inko shikwa
<<MINI>>
ya bunayya ilayya ilayya
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai pade ran me talwaaro naize
Zaqm koi tumhe aa na jaaye
Dekh kar aana ban hai andhera
<<MINI>>
ya bunayya ilayya ilayya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya anees haale maqtal sunaaye
goonjti thi ye do hi sadaaye'n
Ya sakina sakina sakina
<<MINI>>
ya bunayya ilayya ilayya
